data.user: We think recording started with it.
data.response: The history of sound recording has four main periods: Acoustic (1877-1925), Electrical (1925-1945), Magnetic (1945-1975), and Digital (1975-present). For Zoom meetings, you can start a recording by clicking 'Record' at the bottom of your meeting window. If cloud recording is enabled, you have the option to record it on this computer or to the cloud. To start recording music at home, visit I Heart My Voice for tips and expert guidance.
